title: StreamChunkDescriptor
description: Lifecycle and telemetry schema for individual in-flight data chunk in TTZip stream coder

uncompressedSize.description: Actual uncompressed byte count contained in this chunk

compressedSize.description: Actual compressed byte count after DEFLATE encoding

chunkCrc32.description: 32-bit unsigned CRC-32 checksum calculated for this chunk payload

isFinalChunk.description: True if this is the terminal chunk of the compressed file stream

state.description: Current lifecycle state of the chunk memory slot
